summary: Iteration 7 verified the 3 newly added audit-gap features: (1) music tracks listing + ffmpeg-based music mixing endpoint, (2) ffmpeg-based real trim endpoint, (3) functional Studio remix Export buttons. 13/13 new backend tests passed; 92/93 across full regression (1 pre-existing flaky storage 500 unrelated). Frontend flows for Edit (music picker + transcript cut -> /trim banner) and Studio remix (clip export -> file download) all working.

minor.issue: video_to_out() omits derived_from from API responses; useful lineage hidden from clients. DB doc has it. Consider exposing it for the UI to show 'derived from <title>'.
Intermittent 500 on storage path (1 flaky failure during regression, ~3% rate). Independent of this session's changes; retry on same uploaded video succeeded.

issues: Add background music button color is fine, but no visual indication of currently-selected track once picker is reopened - selection state resets to default 'upbeat' on toggle; consider persisting selectedTrack across toggles.
Save button is hidden until deleted.size > 0; this is intentional but new users have no visible affordance. Consider always rendering button (disabled) or adding hint text.

action_items: OPTIONAL (low priority): expose derived_from in video_to_out so the UI can link back to source video.
OPTIONAL: harden /api/videos/{id}/clips/render against intermittent storage-path 500 (only 1/93 retries failed); investigate _new_derived_video file write race if it recurs.
OPTIONAL: persist selected music track when re-opening the picker (state currently defaults back to 'upbeat').
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 1440 lines - exceeds 700 line guideline. Splitting helpers (_mix_music_bytes, _trim_bytes, _new_derived_video, MUSIC_TRACKS) into a dedicated media module would improve maintainability.

Music sine generation is hardcoded - works as a 'royalty-free pad' placeholder but is technically not music; product copy says 'background music' which may set wrong expectations. Consider clarifying in UI ('synth pad') or shipping actual audio files later.

/trim and /music endpoints write a new file synchronously inside the request (ffmpeg can take 5-60s); consider moving to BackgroundTasks + polling or returning 202 for very long sources. Acceptable for current 8s test video sizes.

Frontend Edit.jsx hasTranscript depends on transcript.status === 'ready'; works because GET /transcript fills status from videos.transcript_status. Safe but coupling is implicit - good to add a JSDoc comment.
seed_data_creation: Inserted a 5-segment fake transcript doc for video e246c981-27fc-463f-a6ae-3de54b38c6a9 ('QA Test Video') and set transcript_status='ready' so frontend cut/trim UI could be exercised without invoking Whisper. Mongo collection: transcripts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 audit-gap features (music tracks list, music mix endpoint, trim endpoint, Studio remix Export) are confirmed working both at API and UI level. Key uploaded test video id with seeded transcript: e246c981-27fc-463f-a6ae-3de54b38c6a9. New tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_audit_gaps.py - run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest backend/tests/test_iter7_audit_gaps.py`. Music apply on UI takes ~5s (ffmpeg); trim takes ~5s; clip render export ~5-20s. Studio Export download triggers a browser download with filename clip-{ratio}.mp4.
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocking bugs found. Minor RCA on initial UI test miss: edit-save button is conditional on deleted.size > 0; my first script queried it before clicking segments and reported false-negative. Fixed by querying after segment clicks.
